core.headline: Two-bedroom maisonette, Streatham High Road, SW16
core.listing:
A two-bedroom maisonette on Streatham High Road, occupying the first and second floors above a commercial unit with its own entrance. A section 42 lease extension notice has been served and can be assigned to the buyer. The bay-fronted living room measures 4.90m x 4.10m into bay, and the kitchen was fitted in 2022.

The first floor comprises the living room with its bay window to the front, the kitchen measuring 3.20m x 2.30m, and bedroom one measuring 3.85m x 3.05m. The second floor has bedroom two measuring 2.70m x 2.40m and the bathroom.

Access is via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit below. There is a shared bin store. Parking is pay-and-display on adjoining roads.

Streatham station is approximately six minutes' walk, and Streatham Common is approximately ten minutes' walk.

The property is offered at offers in excess of £375,000 and is leasehold with 89 years remaining. Ground rent is £350 per year and doubles every 25 years, with the next increase in 2034. The service charge is £960 per year for the year ending December 2025 and includes buildings insurance. Council Tax is band C. The EPC rating is D. The property is above a dry cleaner's on a main road, and there is some traffic noise to the front. The freeholder owns the shop below. Access is via a rear service yard shared with the commercial unit, and there is a shared bin store. There is a chain involved.
core.summary: Own entrance to this first and second floor maisonette on Streatham High Road. Section 42 lease extension notice served and can be assigned to the buyer. Bay-fronted living room and kitchen fitted in 2022.
